item.description: ### Fixed - **Stats opens fast again for OpenCode users who delete sessions.** After any OpenCode session was deleted, Stats re-read your whole OpenCode history every time it opened (and every time your phone asked for stats), which on a large history took several seconds. It now reads once and goes back to using its saved results. - **The "Exact cost" card says whose cost it is.** Only OpenCode reports a cost, but under "All" the card looked like your total spend. On the Mac it now says "OpenCode only"; on your iPhone it shows under the OpenCode filter. - **A question from Claude is no longer occasionally missed.** When Claude asked you a question at the same moment as other activity in the session, the "needs you" state could be overwritten. Several sessions updating their cost or usage at once could also drop one session's numbers until its next update. - **The privacy notes describe usage checks accurately.** The README now says Anthropic and ChatGPT usage is also checked every 15 minutes while you're idle (if you used that agent here in the past week), lists Amp, and links to how to turn each one off.
